observations: Photo 0: Two orange gas cylinders visible; one foreground cylinder has a valve/regulator connection on top and a stand/sitter; both show wear/scuffs.
Photo 1: Similar view of the cylinders; foreground cylinder valve/regulator top is visible; cylinders appear used.
Photo 2: Close-up of the cylinder body with printed markings/label area; no clear readable brand/model or capacity from the image quality.

claims.evidence: Photos show orange LPG cylinders, but the capacity (12.5kg) and 'foreign-used' status are not clearly readable/confirmable from the provided images.

claims.claim: Get a durable and high-quality foreign-used...
claims.evidence: No test results, inspection stamps, or condition proof beyond visible wear/scuffs in the photos.

risks.risk: Capacity may not be 12.5kg (could be another size); price depends heavily on exact cylinder size.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the cylinder’s stamped/printed capacity marking (e.g., '12.5kg') and serial/inspection details on the body.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not-confirmed size (use the worst-case comparable among the list that matches the seller’s stated item only loosely).

risks.risk: Leak/safety risk: valve/regulator connection condition is not testable from photos.
risks.proof: A short video showing the valve closed/opened and a leak test (soap-bubble test) around the valve/regulator connection.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing safety check (treat as not guaranteed safe until tested).

risks.risk: Expiry/inspection status unknown (cylinder may be due for inspection or condemned).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the inspection/expiry stamp or date on the cylinder body/neck area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as due/unknown inspection status (worst-case used cylinder).

risks.risk: Burner/sitter completeness unknown (photos show a stand/sitter, but burner kit completeness is unclear).
risks.proof: A photo showing the full set included: burner, regulator, hose (if any), and sitter/stand—laid out and labeled.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cylinder only (no guaranteed burner/regulator/hose included).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the cylinder markings showing capacity (12.5kg) and any serial/inspection dates.
Video of a soap-bubble leak test at the valve/regulator connection (with cylinder upright).
Photo showing exactly what is included in the sale (burner, regulator, hose, sitter/stand) and their condition.
Photo of the cylinder valve type and any safety cap/cover status.
response.reason: The photos confirm used LPG cylinders with a valve/stand, but the key pricing driver (exact 12.5kg capacity) and safety/inspection status cannot be verified from the images. Without that, a confident price pick would be unreliable.
